name: sdd-tdd-loop
description: One task at a time: spec -> enumerated use cases -> one test per case, red to green to refactored. Language-agnostic: /sdd-init generates this repo's test-seam profile and language skill. Plain-file task store; no board, no PR mechanics.

wiki_root.title: Business wiki root
wiki_root.description: The business-wiki plugin's wiki, checked before requirements are written. Auto-detected at business-docs/wiki when present; leave empty for projects with no wiki.

rules_root.title: Derived rules root
rules_root.description: The wiki's derived rules JSON, used for keyed lookups. Defaults to a rules/ sibling of the wiki root.

wiki_required.title: Fail without the wiki
wiki_required.description: "true" makes a missing wiki a hard stop instead of a gap recorded in the spec. For projects where a spec derived from code is worse than no spec.
